message.reasoning_content: We need to determine charges based on facts. The case: Using fiddler to capture packets, exploit vulnerability in third-party payment platform, withdraw money illegally from app. That's theft via computer. Also teaching others method, they also stole large amounts. So charges: 盗窃 (theft) and 提供侵入、非法控制计算机信息系统程序、工具? Actually providing method to others could be considered "提供侵入、非法控制计算机信息系统程序、工具". The list includes that label. The act of using software to steal money is "破坏计算机信息系统"? Actually they are not destroying, but illegally accessing and stealing. The appropriate charge is "盗窃" (theft) and "提供侵入、非法控制计算机信息系统程序、工具". Also maybe "诈骗"? No, it's theft. So answer: 盗窃;提供侵入、非法控制计算机信息系统程序、工具.
